privileged_info_for_vlm: The report must be named 'Weekly Pipeline by Stage'. The target module is 'Opportunities'. It must include at least the fields 'Opportunity Name', 'Amount', and 'Sales Stage'. It must be grouped by 'Sales Stage'. Any pre-existing reports with this name were deleted during setup, so the agent must create it from scratch.
